name: Status styles
author: Brett
description: Animations and styling for every status, on builds and on every step. A status that is being worked on moves its whole row (slow blink, a fade sweeping left to right, pulse, shimmer, stripes…) or only the row's text; a resting status carries a still look. A library of presets, your own saved presets, one pick per status for the row and for the badge, and a moving or still badge for badge packs. Display only: the status comes from the VPS and this maps it to a style, drawn from theme tokens so it follows every skin and stops under reduced motion.

items.title: Status styles: saved styles and own presets
items.description: Reads what is saved over the shipped status styles (the switches and each changed status's row preset, badge preset and animated flag) together with your own presets.

items.title: Status styles: save the style of each status
items.description: Saves the switches and the style picked for each status: its row preset, badge preset and whether its badge is animated. Send {"reset": true} to go back to the shipped styles.

items.title: Status styles: own presets
items.description: Lists the presets you made and saved, and how many built-in presets ship with the plugin.

items.title: Status styles: save an own preset
items.description: Saves one of your own presets (effect, colour, speed, strength, direction and still look); saving again under the same id replaces it. Built-in presets cannot be overwritten.

items.title: Status styles: remove an own preset
items.description: Removes one of your own presets by id. Statuses still using it go back to no style.
